best_idea: Batch every sprite into one fixed vertex buffer and flush on buffer full, texture-slot overflow or a batch-owner switch, with one draw run per blend mode, so draw calls per frame are bounded and counted.
decision_why: Keep the budget, the texture-slot cap and the blend-run split; Frankendom reads the texture-unit cap at start-up on WebGL instead of fixing it at 8, and counts draws per frame in a test. Client-only, so the engine is untouched.
acceptance: A unit test on the batch object (no GPU) asserts a 375-wide fight frame with 60 sprites submits no batch over the quad budget or texture-slot cap and that one blend-mode change adds exactly one draw run; a still at 375 wide shows no missing or flickering sprites across a budget flush.
